entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's Christmas time. The church[n]has been really crowded too.
entries.uk: Різдвяна пора. У церкві[n]теж було дуже людно.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Couples usually spend this[n]time together, don't they?
entries.uk: Зазвичай пари проводять[n]цей час разом, правда?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is there any way we[n]could meet right now...?
entries.uk: Чи можемо ми якось[n]зустрітися просто зараз...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you. I'm honestly[n]a little nervous...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Let's meet in Shibuya. I'll be[n]waiting in front of the station.
